diff_from_blueprint: No HTTP API exists, so docs/api documents the Telegram command and callback contract instead of OpenAPI; the machine-readable artifact is artifacts/api/telegram-interface.json.
No web UI exists, so docs/design documents chat-card UX, Persian RTL behaviour and keyboard hierarchy instead of screens and components in the browser sense.
No authentication is implemented beyond Telegram identity + ADMIN_IDS, so docs/api/authentication.md documents that trust boundary rather than a login flow.
custom personas had no requirement ids, so FR-CPERS-001..005 were added (section 16) after reading handlers and repositories.
